svg.text: Every Pico pin and every module pin. Pico physical numbering, USB to the left, component side up. Module pin order is silkscreen, as printed.
GND node, ONE tie beside pin 38
spare ground — may join GND ring
J2 read from the u.FL end
GND ring, near the AGND tie
switched node → 33 kΩ → tap → 33 kΩ → GND ring
pin 19 → 1 kΩ → anode; cathode → GND ring
3V3 ring → 1 kΩ → anode; cathode → GND ring
all at each module’s own pins
six fitted · stripe → GND on every electrolytic
Pin 40 VBUS is live 5 V and nothing here tolerates 5 V. AGND (33) is a separate plane — tie it once, beside pin 38. Battery switch OFF whenever USB is connected until the Schottky is fitted.
